hero.title: Painting and coating services for industrial assets
hero.body: We help companies maintain asset durability, safety, and appearance through the right coating systems.
hero.imageAlt: Industrial area with equipment and metal surfaces

painting.title: Industrial Painting
painting.body: Professional painting for steel structures, storage tanks, pipes, and industrial equipment using internationally standardized coating materials.

corrosion.title: Anti-Corrosion Coating
corrosion.body: Anti-corrosion coating systems to extend the lifespan of metal assets in harsh industrial and tropical environments.

floor.title: Floor Coating
floor.body: Epoxy and polyurethane floor coating for factories, warehouses, and industrial facilities — resistant to heavy loads, chemicals, and easy to clean.

sandblasting.title: Sandblasting
sandblasting.body: Surface preparation using sandblasting techniques to ensure optimal coating adhesion on various substrate types.

heat.title: High-Temperature Coating
heat.body: Special coating for surfaces exposed to high temperatures such as boilers, chimneys, and hot process equipment.

maintenance.title: Maintenance Painting
maintenance.body: Scheduled maintenance painting programs to keep industrial assets in optimal condition and minimize long-term repair costs.
